manual_observations.issue: Question-only filter plan invents a specific target; filtering follows the invented target
manual_observations.question: What key adjustments did c make to the lawn mower, and how can those adjustments be concisely described as a whole?
manual_observations.invented_plan: C adjusts the height of the lawn mower's deck
manual_observations.source: #C C fixes the engine with the machine
manual_observations.filter_explanation: Does not directly relate to adjusting the lawn mower deck height
manual_observations.score: N and L correct; O and O+ wrong
manual_observations.attribution_limit: Directly confirms plan drift and loss of engine evidence. No counterfactual rerun proves this change alone would fix QA.

manual_observations.observation: L answer evidence includes washing frying pan with sponge at intervals [5,6),[7,9),[11,12),[14,15). All 23 frozen O sources omit washing/rinsing the pan.

manual_observations.issue: Sentence-local filter asks each partial observation to establish a global answer
manual_observations.observation: The two-phase question repeatedly rejects individual observations because a single sentence cannot identify both phases. Sources themselves also omit the bedroom/kitchen distinction required by the correct option.
manual_observations.attribution_limit: Confirms reasoning pattern; cannot attribute this case solely to filtering because source coverage also fails.

manual_observations.issue: Role errors survive extraction, selection and bound rendering

additional_examples: S26 dips brush in water retains instrument=water
Broccoli case a4663dd4 S39 extracts extra verb=in; O+ drops this malformed group

manual_observations.issue: O+ answer can regress while all selected groups survive
manual_observations.observation: O correctly selects setup-then-resistance-band exercises; O+ selects upper-body-then-lower-body. Zero empty composition groups.
manual_observations.attribution_limit: Difference is downstream of shared selection: presentation and reader response, not O+ group deletion. Exact semantic trigger requires a controlled ablation.

interpretation: O+ net +3 is small; no robust accuracy benefit demonstrated by this paired cohort.
All +3 net gain occurs in the 15 cases with group deletion; 285 cases without deletion have 7 gains and 7 regressions. This observational partition does not establish deletion causality.
O/O+ versus L confounds source coverage, extraction, relevance filtering, and presentation. N comparison partly controls source selection but not the remainder of the pipeline.

O+ model rendering cost mean 15.9838 seconds/question; final-reader time savings versus O mean 0.1323 seconds/question. Source retrieval cost excluded; shared GPU observations, not controlled speed ratios.
prioritized_next_ablations: Freeze sources and extraction, compare current filter plan versus no generated filter plan; no question/options-specific rules.
Same frozen source: original-text reader versus all-extracted-units reader versus filtered reader; separates extraction and relevance loss.
Compare fixed compact rendering without group deletion versus current O+; separate presentation from further group filtering, avoid unnecessary compose calls if equal.
Audit missing-source cases separately; O+ cannot reconstruct unobserved evidence without inventing facts.
